analyst_assumptions.physical_da: Physical and software depreciation is assumed at 1.6% of ex-China sales, not a disclosed ex-China expense split. FY2025 total D&A of 85.1 million less acquired amortization of 14.8 million gives consolidated physical and software depreciation of 70.3 million.
analyst_assumptions.maintenance: Scenario maintenance investment is 2.4–3.0% of sales, with sensitivity of 2.2–3.5%, based on multi-year capital spending and replacement uncertainty.
analyst_assumptions.growth_ppe: Expansion investment is 14–18% of incremental sales, a bounded proxy using retained physical asset scale, not a certified closing allocation.
analyst_assumptions.nwc: Working capital consumes 10–18% of incremental sales, or 22% in stress. No automatic cash release is assumed on contraction.
analyst_assumptions.margin_reinvestment: Positive incremental NOPAT attributable to margin improvement is divided by an assumed return of 15%, 20% or 25% to calculate an additional implementation reserve.
analyst_assumptions.china: Adverse, central and favorable assumptions respectively: enterprise value of 300, 400 and 400 million; transaction costs and taxes of 45, 30 and 15 million; discounts of 40%, 20% and 0% on the proportional 19% retained interest; royalty net present values of 0, 50 and 100 million; realization delays of 1.5, 0.5 and 0.5 years. Allocated Chinese debt of 74.5 million is added back within the gross business asset because total consolidated debt is already deducted separately. No additional 80 million of cash is credited.
analyst_assumptions.denominator: The quarterly diluted-average share count of 136.097723 million is a conservative proxy, not an exact current register. October share reductions are not adopted without matched repurchase cash.
analyst_assumptions.rate: Risk-free rate 4.88%, equity risk premium 4.41%, estimated risk loading 1.10, debt cost 5% and tax rate 25%. Market capital weights yield a WACC of 9.309302%.
analyst_assumptions.amortization: Acquired amortization remains an economic replacement-cost proxy. Only physical and software depreciation is added back; no additional acquired-amortization tax shield is credited.
analyst_assumptions.inverse: Growth of 8.01356% for five years supports the reference price in the central model, with first-year FCFF of 406.4 million. The alternative margin inverse has unfunded first-year cash flow of negative 278.4 million and is only a mathematical diagnostic, not a financed operating plan.
